title: 2025 Press Releases
summary: This source is a Federal Reserve Board press release index page for calendar year 2025, containing links to dozens of individual announcements spanning monetary policy, banking applications, enforcement actions, regulatory guidance, and market infrastructure updates. The page itself is non-archiveable as a listing page and does not contain the full text of any individual document.
key_points: Source is a listing/index page, not a single archiveable document.
Contains link to FOMC meeting minutes (December 9-10, 2025 meeting dated 12/30/2025) which would be relevant to macro catalysts.
Contains link to Fedwire expanded operating days announcement (10/9/2025) which relates to market structure payment infrastructure.
Includes numerous banking applications, enforcement actions, and regulatory proposals not directly relevant to market structure or macro catalysts.
Many entries pertain to consumer regulatory policy, appraisal requirements, and stress test transparency—peripheral to core market structure or macro catalysts topics.
why_it_matters: This page serves as a navigation index to Federal Reserve communications in 2025. Individual items within the listing (e.g., FOMC minutes, balance sheet updates, payment system changes) would be relevant for market structure and macro catalysts research, but the listing page itself provides only metadata summaries rather than full content.
market_structure_context: One relevant item identified: the 10/9/2025 announcement about Fedwire Funds Service and National Settlement Service expanding operating days to include Sundays and weekday holidays—this is a market infrastructure/payment system change with potential market structure implications.
